Chapter 11.2.2, Compressibility Factors for Hydrocarbons: 0.500-0.61 Relative Density Range and 20-128 $ ^{\circ} \mathrm{F} $ , First Edition, 1984

This standard contains compressibility factors related to meter temperature and relative density (60°F/60°F) of the metered material. Its purpose is to correct hydrocarbon volumes metered under pressure to the coresponding volumes at the equilibrium pressure for the metered temperature. 13 pages.

Price each, $5.0
